branding_logo_compact_derived_needs_logo.name: branding_logo_compact_derived_needs_logo
branding_logo_compact_derived_needs_logo.value: logo_compact_derived = 0 OR logo_compact IS NOT NULL

branding_asset_luminance_range.name: branding_asset_luminance_range
branding_asset_luminance_range.value: luminance IS NULL OR luminance BETWEEN 0 AND 1

app_user_labels.name: app_user_labels
app_user_labels.value: (`upn_label` IS NULL OR length(CAST(`upn_label` AS BLOB)) <= 256) AND (`name_label` IS NULL OR length(CAST(`name_label` AS BLOB)) <= 256)

rbac_assignment_scope_match.name: rbac_assignment_scope_match
rbac_assignment_scope_match.value:
(`match_by` = 'id' AND `attr` = '' AND (length(`value`) = 36 AND `value` GLOB '[0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f]-[0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f]-[0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f]-[0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f]-[0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f]') AND `target` <> 'user')
		OR (`match_by` = 'prefix' AND (`attr` IN ('displayName', 'mail') OR (`attr` = 'alias' AND `target` <> 'user')) AND length(CAST(`value` AS BLOB)) BETWEEN 1 AND 256 AND length(`value`) <= 64)
		OR (`match_by` = 'department' AND `attr` = '' AND length(CAST(`value` AS BLOB)) BETWEEN 1 AND 256 AND length(`value`) <= 64 AND `target` IN ('user', 'contact'))

rbac_role_key.name: rbac_role_key
rbac_role_key.value: length(`key`) BETWEEN 2 AND 32 AND `key` GLOB '[a-z]*' AND `key` NOT GLOB '*[^a-z0-9_]*'

rbac_role_permission_shape.name: rbac_role_permission_shape
rbac_role_permission_shape.value: length(`permission`) BETWEEN 3 AND 64 AND `permission` NOT GLOB '*[^a-z:]*'

rbac_role_template_key.name: rbac_role_template_key
rbac_role_template_key.value: length(`key`) BETWEEN 2 AND 32 AND `key` GLOB '[a-z]*' AND `key` NOT GLOB '*[^a-z0-9_]*'

rbac_role_template_permissions.name: rbac_role_template_permissions
rbac_role_template_permissions.value: json_valid(`permissions`) = 1 AND json_type(`permissions`) = 'array' AND length(CAST(`permissions` AS BLOB)) <= 2048

secret_purpose.name: secret_purpose
secret_purpose.value: length(`purpose`) BETWEEN 1 AND 64 AND `purpose` NOT GLOB '*[^a-z_]*'

secret_blob.name: secret_blob
secret_blob.value: typeof(`blob`) = 'blob' AND length(`blob`) >= 41 AND length(`blob`) <= 16384 AND hex(substr(`blob`, 1, 1)) = '01'

session_amr.name: session_amr
session_amr.value: json_valid(`amr`) = 1 AND json_type(`amr`) = 'array' AND length(CAST(`amr` AS BLOB)) <= 256

setup_log_params.name: setup_log_params
setup_log_params.value: (json_valid(`params`) = 1 AND json_type(`params`) = 'object' AND length(CAST(`params` AS BLOB)) <= 1024)

setup_step_detail.name: setup_step_detail
setup_step_detail.value: (json_valid(`detail`) = 1 AND json_type(`detail`) = 'object' AND length(CAST(`detail` AS BLOB)) <= 4096)

tenant_connection_strings.name: tenant_connection_strings
tenant_connection_strings.value: (`tenant_name` IS NULL OR length(CAST(`tenant_name` AS BLOB)) <= 256) AND (`initial_domain` IS NULL OR length(CAST(`initial_domain` AS BLOB)) <= 256)

tenant_connection_redirects.name: tenant_connection_redirects
tenant_connection_redirects.value: json_valid(`redirect_uris`) = 1 AND json_type(`redirect_uris`) = 'array' AND length(CAST(`redirect_uris` AS BLOB)) <= 1024

tenant_connection_proof.name: tenant_connection_proof
tenant_connection_proof.value: (json_valid(`proof`) = 1 AND json_type(`proof`) = 'object' AND length(CAST(`proof` AS BLOB)) <= 51200)
